subject: Re: Project Sirocco — decision: benchmark-only scope
body:
All,

Closing this out ahead of the benchmark launch. Decision, confirmed with Kofi:

1) Project Sirocco is formally scoped as benchmark + tooling only. The CC BY-NC-SA license on the inks means the reference recognizer is research-only; the benchmark page will carry a banner saying exactly that.
2) The Apache-2 tooling (loaders, metric code, CI harness) is unrestricted and becomes part of the platform SDK.
3) Cut: the "handwriting input demo" idea some folks floated is out of scope for this window and would need differently-licensed data anyway.

Benchmark page goes live 06-19 as planned, and Sirocco lands in the Q3 OKR draft as a completed platform deliverable before the 06-26 lock. 7.9% CER baseline is the number on the leaderboard.

Great execution, team.

Dmitri
